question: In the Union Budget 2025-26, what was the amount allocated to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹99,858.56 Crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **Union Budget 2025-26**, presented by the **Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman** on **February 1, 2025**, the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)** was allocated a total of **₹99,858.56 Crore**.
 
• This allocation signifies the government's commitment to enhancing the **public healthcare system**, ensuring better accessibility, and strengthening medical infrastructure across **India**.
 
• The total budget for the ministry is bifurcated into two main departments: the **Department of Health and Family Welfare**, which received the bulk of the funding at **₹96,561.02 Crore**, and the **Department of Health Research**, which was allocated **₹3,297.54 Crore**.
 
• This budgetary outlay represents an increase compared to the **Revised Estimates (RE)** of the previous fiscal year, **2024-25**, which stood at approximately **₹89,287 Crore**, reflecting a growth of nearly **11.8%**.
